items.question: Which Republic Act is known as the 'Philippine Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering Act of 2016' that strengthened and modernized the practice of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering?
items.rationale: R.A. 10915 lapsed into law on July 21, 2016, repealing R.A. 8559 and aligning ABE practice with international standards.

items.question: When was Republic Act No. 3927, the original Philippine Agricultural Engineering Law, approved and enacted?
items.rationale: R.A. 3927 was enacted on June 18, 1964 (31 sections), later repealed by R.A. 8559 (1998) and R.A. 10915 (2016).

items.question: Which Philippine law promotes the development and adoption of modern, appropriate, and cost-effective agricultural and fisheries machinery and equipment?
items.rationale: R.A. 10601 (Agricultural and Fisheries Mechanization Law of 2013) governs mechanization, machinery registration, and BAFE.

items.question: Under R.A. 10601, BAFE requires registration of agricultural and fisheries machinery entities abbreviated as MFADDIE. What does MFADDIE stand for?
items.answer: Manufacturer, Fabricator, Assembler, Distributor, Dealer, Importer, and Exporter
items.rationale: All entities engaged in manufacturing, fabricating, assembling, distributing, dealing, importing, or exporting agri-fishery machinery must register with BAFE.
choices: Manufacturer, Foreign Assembler, Distribution, Dealer, Investor, and Employer

Mechanization Facility, Agency, Distributor, Developer, Importer, and Exporter

items.question: Under R.A. 10915, how often must a licensed Agricultural and Biosystems Engineer renew their Professional Identification Card (PIC) with the PRC?
items.rationale: The PRC Professional Identification Card (PIC) is valid for 3 years and renewed upon paying fees and submitting CPD compliance and AIPO (PSABE) Certificate of Good Standing.

items.question: Which of the following are required for the renewal of an Agricultural and Biosystems Engineer's Professional Identification Card (PIC)?
items.answer: CPD units and Certificate of Good Standing from the AIPO (PSABE)
items.rationale: Section 20 of R.A. 10915 requires proof of CPD credit units and a Certificate of Good Standing from the Accredited Integrated Professional Organization (PSABE).

items.question: Under R.A. 10915, which of the following infrastructure projects falls strictly within the signing and sealing authority of an Agricultural and Biosystems Engineer rather than a general municipal barangay road?

items.rationale: ABEs sign and seal plans and specifications for FMRs, irrigation and drainage systems, farm structures, and agri-processing facilities.

items.question: How does the scope of practice of an Agricultural and Biosystems Engineer (ABE) differ from that of a Chemical Engineer (ChE) in processing plants?
items.answer: ABEs handle primary agricultural/bioprocess systems and farm-level value-adding, while ChEs handle industrial chemical plants
items.rationale: Under R.A. 10915, ABEs cover agricultural bioprocess, postharvest, and farm waste systems, whereas industrial chemical manufacturing belongs to ChEs.

items.question: Who is primarily responsible for calibrating, integrating, and preparing technical specifications of agricultural sensors and controlled-environment instrumentation used in precision farming?
items.rationale: Agricultural and Biosystems Automation, Instrumentation, and Control Systems is a core competency area under R.A. 10915 and the PRC ABELE TOS.

items.question: Presidential Decree No. 1594 (later superseded by R.A. 9184) originally prescribed policies, guidelines, rules, and regulations for which of the following?
items.rationale: P.D. 1594 governed government infrastructure project procurement, bidding, and contracts prior to the Government Procurement Reform Act (R.A. 9184).

items.question: What does CPES stand for in the evaluation of government agricultural infrastructure construction projects?
items.rationale: CPES evaluates contractor performance during and upon completion of government infrastructure projects (workmanship, materials, time, facilities, etc.).

items.question: Under Philippine environmental regulations (R.A. 8749 / DENR-EMB), what document must an agri-processing facility with air pollution source equipment (such as a rice hull furnace or boiler) secure before operating?
items.rationale: A Permit to Operate (PTO) Air Pollution Source Installations (APSI) is issued by DENR-EMB to ensure emissions comply with Clean Air Act standards.

items.question: Under R.A. 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000), which unit is primarily mandated to establish Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs) and implement segregated collection at the community level?
items.rationale: R.A. 9003 places primary responsibility for solid waste segregation, MRFs, and 10-year solid waste management plans on LGUs and barangays.

items.question: According to the 2013 PHilMech study, what was the average level of agricultural mechanization in the Philippines for all crops, and specifically for rice farms?
items.rationale: PHilMech's 2013 benchmark established 1.23 hp/ha across all crops and 2.31 hp/ha for rice cultivation.

items.question: Which stage of agricultural evolution is characterized by the integration of IoT sensors, AI, drones, cloud computing, and autonomous robotics for real-time precision farm management?
items.rationale: Ag 1.0 = manual/animal labor; Ag 2.0 = mechanization & chemical inputs (Green Revolution); Ag 3.0 = GPS/precision guidance; Ag 4.0 = IoT, AI, big data, and smart autonomous farming.

items.question: Which historical phase of farming corresponds to Agriculture 2.0?
items.answer: Widespread adoption of tractors, synthetic fertilizers, and high-yielding varieties

choices: Autonomous swarm robotics and digital twins

items.question: Which statement best distinguishes digitalization, automation, and robotics in Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering?
items.answer: Digitalization converts farm data to digital form; automation executes tasks without continuous human intervention; robotics uses programmable physical machines to sense and act
items.rationale: Digitalization handles data capture/processing, automation handles self-regulating control loops, and robotics combines electromechanical actuation with sensing.
choices: Automation and digitalization mean exactly the same thing
Robotics only refers to software spreadsheets

items.question: What does ROPS stand for on four-wheel agricultural tractors?
items.rationale: ROPS is a cab or frame structure engineered to protect tractor operators from crush injuries during tractor overturns.

At 11% annual discount rate, it has the following feasibility indicators: net present value of 1.8 billion pesos and internal rate of return of 58%. If annual discount rate drops to 10%, will it be feasible?
items.rationale: Reducing the discount rate from 11% to 10% increases the present value of net cash inflows above the existing Php 1.8 billion NPV, and 10% remains well below the 58% IRR, so the project remains feasible.

items.question: You are tasked to evaluate the financial feasibility of a 3-year AFMESC project. It has the following costs for years 0, 1, 2 and 3 in million Php: 5, 1, 2 and 3, respectively. Likewise, the same project has the following benefits for years 0, 1, 2 and 3 in million Php: 0, 6, 8 and 9, respectively. What is its Net Present Value and indicate if the project is feasible or not based on NPV? Use the NEDA published Social Discount Rate (SDR) of 10%.
items.rationale: Net cash flows (B − C) for years 0 to 3 are −5, +5, +6, and +6 million Php; discounting at 10% yields NPV = −5 + 5/1.1 + 6/1.1² + 6/1.1³ ≈ −5 + 4.55 + 4.96 + 4.51 = Php 9.01M (≈ Php 9M > 0), confirming the project is financially feasible.

A 24-volt battery of a boom sprayer needs to be charged on field using 6-volt solar modules with 2 modules in parallel to speed up charging. How many solar modules are required?
items.rationale:
Given: Battery voltage = 24 V; Solar module voltage = 6 V; Parallel strings = 2.
Modules in series = V_battery / V_module = 24 V / 6 V = 4 modules.
Total modules = Series modules × Parallel strings = 4 × 2 = 8 modules (Eight).

items.question: What is the actual horsepower of a tractor needed to do 149.2 kW-hrs of work in 2 hours?
items.rationale:
Given: Work (W) = 149.2 kW-hr; Time (t) = 2 hr.
Power (P) = W / t = 149.2 kW-hr / 2 hr = 74.6 kW.
Convert to hp (1 hp = 0.746 kW): P = 74.6 kW / 0.746 kW/hp = 100 hp.

items.question: A 24-volt battery of a pineapple harvesting conveyor needs to be charged on field using 12-volt solar modules. What is the minimum number of solar modules required?
items.rationale:
Given: Battery voltage = 24 V; Solar module voltage = 12 V.
Minimum modules in series = V_battery / V_module = 24 V / 12 V = 2 modules (Two).

items.question: You plan to innovate a 48-volt battery of a solar-powered small equipment transport vehicle which uses 12-volt solar modules. What is the minimum number of solar modules required to effect charging of its battery?
items.rationale:
Given: Battery voltage = 48 V; Solar module voltage = 12 V.
Minimum modules in series = V_battery / V_module = 48 V / 12 V = 4 modules (Four).

items.question: A new tractor brand is being tested. The tachometer placed at the Power Take-Off (PTO) shaft recorded an average rotational speed of 1,700 RPM. The indicated engine power of 100 hp was found to be true. What likelihood value of torque was likely recorded at the PTO shaft?
items.rationale:
Given: Power (P) = 100 hp; Rotational speed (N) = 1,700 RPM.
Formula: T = (5,252 × P) / N
T = (5,252 × 100 hp) / 1,700 RPM = 308.94 ft-lbs ≈ 309 ft-lbs.

items.question: You need to purchase a tractor. Results of your calculation indicate that the PTO power needed for the routinary task intended for the tractor is 54 kW. What should be the minimum engine power in hp? Consider that the continuous work of the tractor at the PTO shaft should not exceed 78% of the engine power.
items.rationale:
Given: Required PTO power = 54 kW; Maximum continuous PTO ratio = 78% (0.78).
Engine power (kW) = 54 kW / 0.78 = 69.23 kW.
Convert to hp: 69.23 kW / 0.746 kW/hp = 92.80 hp.
Rounding up to the nearest standard rating that satisfies the minimum requirement gives 95 hp.

items.question: The testing instrument at the tractor Power Take-Off (PTO) shaft registers 1,700 RPM and 310 ft-lbs torque. Determine the PTO power.
items.rationale:
Given: Rotational speed (N) = 1,700 RPM; Torque (T) = 310 ft-lbs.
Formula: P = (T × N) / 5,252
P = (310 × 1,700) / 5,252 = 100.34 hp ≈ 100 hp.

items.question: In a PTO power test, the drawbar power of a 2-wheel drive tractor was found to be 29 kW when harrowing on a plowed field. The drawbar to PTO power conversion factor of a 2-wheel drive tractor working in a previously tilled surface is estimated at 0.67. What is the result of the PTO power test?
items.rationale:
Given: Drawbar power (P_DB) = 29 kW; Drawbar-to-PTO conversion factor = 0.67.
Formula: P_PTO = P_DB / Conversion Factor
P_PTO = 29 kW / 0.67 = 43.28 kW ≈ 43 kW.

items.question: Determine the daily energy output of a 24-volt DC solar pump during a sunny day in Luzon with latitude of 16 degrees north if its overall power output is 750 watt-peak and the daily sensible sunlight in the location is 5 hours. Choose only ONE best answer.
items.rationale:
Given: Power output (P) = 750 Wp = 0.75 kW; Daily sensible sunlight (t) = 5 hours.
Formula: E = P × t
E = 0.75 kW × 5 hr = 3.75 kWh.

items.question: The specific heat of gasoline is 0.53 kcal/(kg °C). If the current temperature of a 1 kg gasoline is 100°C, find the amount of energy needed to further increase it to 110°C. Choose only ONE best answer.
items.rationale:
Given: Specific heat (c) = 0.53 kcal/(kg °C); Mass (m) = 1 kg; ΔT = 110°C − 100°C = 10°C.
Formula: Q = m × c × ΔT
Q = 1 kg × 0.53 kcal/(kg °C) × 10°C = 5.3 kcal.

items.question: A solar water heater installed in Mindanao at latitude of 8 degrees north is used for pre-heating water prior to entry into industrial-size boilers. The heater has a collection area of 3.6 meters × 5 meters, and efficiency of 9%. Estimate its power output during a sunny noon and if you are tasked to carry out the installation, what is its installation tilt angle and north-south orientation.
items.rationale:
Given: Area (A) = 3.6 m × 5 m = 18 m²; Efficiency (η) = 9% = 0.09; Sunny noon solar irradiance (I) = 1,000 W/m² = 1 kW/m²; Latitude = 8° N.
Power output: P = A × I × η = 18 m² × 1 kW/m² × 0.09 = 1.62 kW ≈ 1.6 kW.
Orientation & Tilt: Since the site is in the Northern Hemisphere (8° N), the collector faces south with a practical minimum tilt angle of 10 degrees. Answer = 1.6 kW, 10 degrees facing south.

items.question: A 360-watt power from a 12-volt DC generator is to be used for AC farm machine by using an inverter. What is the power output from the inverter if inversion efficiency is 85%? Choose only ONE best answer.
items.rationale:
Given: Input power (P_in) = 360 watts; Inversion efficiency (η) = 85% = 0.85.
Formula: P_out = P_in × η
P_out = 360 watts × 0.85 = 306 watts.

items.question: An AC generator is rated at a real power of 90 kW with an indicated power factor of 0.82, what is the apparent power of the generator? Choose only ONE best answer.
items.rationale:
Given: Real power (P) = 90 kW; Power factor (pf) = 0.82.
Formula: Apparent power (S) = P / pf
S = 90 kW / 0.82 = 109.76 kVA ≈ 110 kVA.

items.question: Estimate the dependable power output from a windpump having a rotor diameter of 8 meters, average blade twist angle of 45 degrees, and tip speed ratio of 1:1 if the daytime prevailing windspeed in the location is 3 meters/second. Choose only ONE best answer.
items.rationale:
Given: Rotor diameter (D) = 8 m; Wind speed (V) = 3 m/s.
Swept area: A = (π / 4) D² = (π / 4)(8 m)² = 50.27 m² (≈ 50 m²).
Using the standard ABE dependable windpump power formula (P_d = 0.1 × A × V³):
P_d = 0.1 × 50.27 × 3³ = 135.7 W ≈ 135 watts.

items.question: An AC generator is rated at an apparent power of 100 kVA with a power factor of 0.8, what is the real power of the generator in hp? Choose only ONE best answer.
items.rationale:
Given: Apparent power (S) = 100 kVA; Power factor (pf) = 0.8.
Real power (kW): P = S × pf = 100 kVA × 0.8 = 80 kW.
Convert to hp: P = 80 kW / 0.746 kW/hp = 107.24 hp ≈ 107 hp.

items.question: An AC generator is rated at an apparent power of 100 kVA with a power factor of 0.8, what is the real power of the generator in kW?
items.rationale:
Given: Apparent power (S) = 100 kVA; Power factor (pf) = 0.8.
Formula: Real power (P) = S × pf
P = 100 kVA × 0.8 = 80 kW.

items.question: A picohydro generator is to be used as power source for an analog pressure transmitter sending real-time data on water depth at dam outlet. The pressure transmitter has a voltage of 15 Volts DC and amperage of 20 milliamperes. What minimum power output and voltage of picohydro generator should you request for purchasing?
items.rationale:
Given: Voltage (V) = 15 Vdc; Current (I) = 20 mA.
Formula: P = V × I
P = 15 V × 20 mA = 300 milliwatts (0.3 W) at 15 Vdc.
Answer = 300 milliwatts, 15 Vdc.

items.question: The specific heat of diesel is 0.48 kcal/(kg °C). If the current temperature of a 1 kg diesel is 200°C, find the amount of energy needed to further increase it to 210°C.
items.rationale:
Given: Specific heat (c) = 0.48 kcal/(kg °C); Mass (m) = 1 kg; ΔT = 210°C − 200°C = 10°C.
Formula: Q = m × c × ΔT
Q = 1 kg × 0.48 kcal/(kg °C) × 10°C = 4.8 kcal.

items.question: The wind flows on a 2m-diameter rotor at a rate of 2 m/s. It suddenly flows at 4 m/s, what would be the power output of the windmill?
items.rationale:
Given: V₁ = 2 m/s; V₂ = 4 m/s.
Wind power is proportional to the cube of wind velocity (P ∝ V³).
P₂ / P₁ = (V₂ / V₁)³ = (4 / 2)³ = 2³ = 8 times.

items.question: Determine the rotor speed of a windmill with a wind tip-speed ratio of 1:1 and a wind velocity of 2m/s.
items.rationale:
Given: Tip-speed ratio (TSR) = 1:1 = 1; Wind velocity (V_wind) = 2 m/s.
Formula: TSR = V_tip / V_wind
V_tip = TSR × V_wind = 1 × 2 m/s = 2 m/s (2m/s).

items.question: A diesel engine operating at 2500 rpm will be used to drive an irrigation pump operating at 1000 rpm. The pulley diameter for the pump is 4 inches. What is the recommended size of pulley for the engine?
items.rationale:
Given: N₁ = 2,500 rpm (engine); N₂ = 1,000 rpm (pump); D₂ = 4 in.
Formula: N₁ D₁ = N₂ D₂
D₁ = (N₂ × D₂) / N₁ = (1,000 rpm × 4 in.) / 2,500 rpm = 1.6 in (or use 2 in. standard pulley).

items.question: An irrigation pump is driven by a single cylinder engine. The set-up has the following specifications: engine rpm, 2200; pump rpm, 1800; and diameter of engine pulley, 25 cm. What should be the diameter of the pump pulley?
items.rationale:
Given: N₁ = 2,200 rpm; N₂ = 1,800 rpm; D₁ = 25 cm.
Formula: N₁ D₁ = N₂ D₂
D₂ = (N₁ × D₁) / N₂ = (2,200 rpm × 25 cm) / 1,800 rpm = 30.56 cm (30.55 cm).

items.question: The cylinder of a corn sheller will be driven by a 10-hp diesel engine using V-belt drive. The engine has a speed of 1800 rpm while the corn sheller requires an engine speed of 650 rpm. The effective diameter of the driver pulley is 12 inches. What should be the diameter of the driven pulley?
items.rationale:
Given: N₁ = 1,800 rpm (driver); N₂ = 650 rpm (driven); D₁ = 12 in.
Formula: N₁ D₁ = N₂ D₂
D₂ = (N₁ × D₁) / N₂ = (1,800 rpm × 12 in.) / 650 rpm = 33.23 in. ≈ 33 in.

items.question: A 10-hp diesel engine drives the cylinder of a corn sheller through a V-belt drive at an engine shaft speed of 1,800 rpm. What is the recommended shaft diameter for the engine drive? Assume a design stress of 6,000 psi.
items.rationale:
Given: Design power (P) = 10 hp; Shaft speed (N) = 1,800 rpm; Design stress (S_d) = 6,000 psi.
Torque: T = (63,025 × P) / N = (63,025 × 10) / 1,800 = 350.14 in-lb.
Shaft diameter: D = [16 T / (π S_d)]^(1/3) = [16 × 350.14 / (π × 6,000)]^(1/3) = 0.667 in. ≈ 0.66 in.

items.question: Compute the torque acting on a pulley rotating at 1800 rpm and delivering a power of 10 kW. If the pulley used in transmitting power runs at 1800 rpm has a diameter of 8 in., what is the force transmitted by the belt? Also, compute the actual load applied to the pulley shaft. If 6200 single-row deep-groove ball bearing will be used to drive the pulley, what would be the rating fatigue life of the bearing? What is the rated life in hours of the bearing?
items.rationale:
Given: N = 1,800 rpm; P = 10 kW; Pulley diameter D = 8 in. (r = 4 in. = 101.6 mm); Bearing = 6200 (basic dynamic load rating C = 400 kgf).
1. Torque: M = 974,000 × P / N = 974,000 × 10 / 1,800 = 5,411.1 kgf-mm.
2. Belt force: F = M / r = 5,411.1 / 101.6 = 53.26 kgf.
3. Actual shaft load (V-belt tension factor f_b = 2.25): K = 2.25 × 53.26 = 119.83 kgf.
4. Speed factor: f_n = (33.3 / 1,800)^(1/3) = 0.2645.
5. Fatigue life factor: f_h = f_n × (C / K) = 0.2645 × (400 / 119.83) = 0.883.
6. Rated life in hours: L_h = 500 × f_h³ = 500 × (0.8833)³ ≈ 344.62 hours.

items.question: Recommend a shaft size required for the main transmission shaft of a rice mill prime mover with the following specifications: Engine, Isuzu 8 PA; Hp rated, 225 Hp; and Engine Speed, 3600 rpm. Use 6,000-psi design stress for the shaft. Recommend a square-key size for the calculated shaft. Assume a size of key of ½" square.
items.rationale:
Given: P = 225 hp; N = 3,600 rpm; S_d = 6,000 psi; Square key width (w) = 0.5 in.; Allowable crushing stress (S_c) = 25,000 psi.
Torque: T = (63,025 × 225) / 3,600 = 3,939.06 in-lb.
Shaft diameter: D = [16 × 3,939.06 / (π × 6,000)]^(1/3) = 1.495 in. ≈ 1.5 in. (use 2-in. shaft, radius r = 1 in.).
Tangential force: F = T / r = 3,939.06 / 1 = 3,939 lb.
Required key length: L = F / (w × S_c) = 3,939 / (0.5 × 25,000) = 0.315 in. ≈ 0.32 in.

items.question: A shaft delivers 10 lbs at 10-cm crank radius. What is the torque delivered by the shaft? If the said shaft rotates at 80 rpm, what is the power delivered by the shaft?
items.rationale:
Given: Force (F) = 10 lbs; Crank radius (R) = 10 cm = 10 / 2.54 = 3.937 in.; Speed (N) = 80 rpm.
Torque: T = F × R = 10 lbs × 3.937 in. = 39.37 in-lb (or 45.45 kg-cm).
Power: Hp = (T × N) / 63,025 = (39.37 × 80) / 63,025 = 0.04997 Hp ≈ 0.05 Hp.

items.question: A solid shaft delivers 1000 in-lb torque at 800 rpm rotation, what shaft diameter would you recommend? Recommended design stress is 6,000 psi.
items.rationale:
Given: Torque (T) = 1,000 in-lb; Speed (N) = 800 rpm; Design stress (S_d) = 6,000 psi.
Formula: D = [16 T / (π S_d)]^(1/3)
D = [16 × 1,000 / (π × 6,000)]^(1/3) = 0.947 in. ≈ 0.9 in. (use 1" Ø standard shaft).
Answer = 0.9 in. use 1" Ø.

items.question: Compute the drawbar pull and drawbar horsepower of a 4-bottom moldboard plow on a clay loam soil having an effective width of cut of 0.3 m per bottom and a depth of cut of 0.15 m. The plowing speed is 10 kph. (Soil draft for clay loam soil is assumed at 8 psi).
items.rationale:
Given: Bottoms = 4; Width/bottom = 0.3 m; Depth = 0.15 m; Speed (V) = 10 kph = 2.778 m/s; Specific draft = 8 psi.
Total cross-sectional area: A = 4 × 0.3 m × 0.15 m = 0.18 m² = 279 in².
Drawbar pull (F): F = 8 lb/in² × 279 in² = 2,232 lb = 1,012.4 kgf.
Drawbar horsepower (using 1 hp = 76.2 kgf-m/s): DHP = (1,012.4 kgf × 2.778 m/s) / 76.2 = 36.9 hp.

items.question: What is the drawbar pull required for a 3-meter tractor-drawn offset-disk harrow. The implement specific draft is 89 kg/m. Also compute the drawbar horsepower of the implement if it is running at a speed of 20 kph.
items.rationale:
Given: Width (W) = 3 m; Specific draft = 89 kg/m; Speed (V) = 20 kph = 5.556 m/s.
Drawbar pull (F): F = W × specific draft = 3 m × 89 kg/m = 267 kgf.
Drawbar horsepower (using 1 hp = 76.2 kgf-m/s): DHP = (267 kgf × 5.556 m/s) / 76.2 = 19.47 hp ≈ 19.5 hp.

items.question: A 16-hp rotary tiller is tilling at a depth of 10 cm. Its rotating tiller has a width of 0.5 m. What is the specific power output of the machine if it is traveling at a speed of 0.5 m/sec? Assume a 0.80 power transmission efficiency for the tiller.
items.rationale:
Given: Power input = 16 hp, depth = 10 cm, width = 0.5 m = 50 cm, speed = 0.5 m/sec = 50 cm/sec, transmission efficiency = 0.80.
Formula: SPO = P_out / (W × D × V) = (P_in × η × 746 W/hp) / (W × D × V)
Substitution: SPO = (16 × 0.80 × 746 W) / (50 cm × 10 cm × 50 cm/sec) = 9,548.8 W / 25,000 cm³/sec = 0.382 Watts/cm³.
Answer = 0.382 Watts/cm³

items.question: Compute the drawbar pull of a plow on a power tiller with depth and width of cut of 10 cm × 8 cm. The number of plow bottom is 2. Soil draft is equal to 5 psi. If the plow is drawn at a speed of 10 km/hr, what is the drawbar horsepower of the plow?
items.rationale:
Given: Depth = 10 cm, width = 8 cm, n = 2 bottoms, soil draft = 5 psi, speed V = 10 km/hr.
Formula: A = D × W × n; F = A × Draft; DHP = (F × V) / 76.2 kg-m/sec-hp
Substitution: A = 10 cm × 8 cm × 2 = 160 cm². F = 160 cm² × (5 lb/in²) × (1 in / 2.54 cm)² × (1 kg / 2.2 lb) = 56.36 kg. Using V = 10 km/hr × (1000 m/km) / (3600 sec/hr) ≈ 2.77 m/sec (rounded): DHP = (56.36 kg × 2.77 m/sec) / 76.2 ≈ 2.04 Hp (exact unrounded = 2.05 Hp).
Answer = 2.04 Hp

items.question: Compute the force exerted by the hand tractor cage wheel with 0.8-m wheel diameter. The wheel is drawn by a 10-hp robin engine driving the cage wheel at 30 rpm. The transmission efficiency of the machine is 0.90.
items.rationale:
Given: Diameter D = 0.8 m (radius R = 0.4 m), engine power = 10 hp, wheel speed N = 30 rpm, transmission efficiency η = 0.90.
Formula: Axle power P = P_e × η × 4572 kg-m/min-hp; Tangential speed v = 2πRN = πDN; Force F = P / (2πRN)
Substitution: F = (10 × 0.90 × 4572 kg-m/min) / (2π × 0.4 m × 30 rpm) = 41,148 / 75.398 = 545.74 kg.
Answer = 545.74 kg

items.question: What is the drawbar horsepower of a plow requiring a drawbar pull of 253 kg if the plowing speed is 5 kph?
items.rationale:
Given: From the preceding problem, drawbar pull F = 253 kg; plowing speed V = 5 km/hr.
Formula: DHP = (F × V) / 76.2 kg-m/sec-hp
Substitution: V = 5 km/hr × (1000 m/km) / (3600 sec/hr) = 1.389 m/sec. DHP = (253 kg × 1.389 m/sec) / 76.2 = 4.61 hp ≈ 4.6 hp.
Answer = 4.6 hp

items.question: What is the required drawbar pull for a 5-meter tractor-drawn spike-tooth harrow with a specific draft of 89 kg/m? What is the drawbar horsepower of the implement if it is running at a speed of 6 kph?
items.rationale:
Given: Width W = 5 m, specific draft Ds = 89 kg/m, speed V = 6 km/hr.
Formula: F = Ds × W; DHP = (F × V) / 76.2 kg-m/sec-hp
Substitution: F = 89 kg/m × 5 m = 445 kg. DHP = (445 kg × 6 km/hr × 1000 m/km / 3600 sec/hr) / 76.2 = 741.67 / 76.2 = 9.73 hp ≈ 10 hp.
Answer = 10 hp

items.question: A water pump requires 64.75 hp to operate. If a diesel engine with an efficiency of 80% will be used to drive the pump, what is the recommended horsepower for the engine?
items.rationale:
Given: From Problem 38, pump horsepower PHP ≈ 64.75 hp (rounded to 64.8 hp); diesel engine efficiency η = 80% = 0.80.
Formula: EHP = PHP / η
Substitution: EHP = 64.75 hp / 0.80 = 80.9 hp (64.8 / 0.80 = 81.0 hp).
Answer = 80.9 hp

items.question: A water pump requires 64.75 hp to operate. If a gasoline engine with an efficiency of 70% will be used to drive the pump, what is the power requirement of the engine?
items.rationale:
Given: From Problem 38, pump horsepower PHP ≈ 64.75 hp (rounded to 64.8 hp); gasoline engine efficiency η = 70% = 0.70.
Formula: EHP = PHP / η
Substitution: EHP = 64.75 hp / 0.70 = 92.5 hp.
Answer = 92.5 hp

items.question: A tractor operating at 3.5 mph develops a drawbar pull of 3000 pounds. Estimate the required drawbar horsepower for the tractor.
items.rationale:
Given: Speed V = 3.5 mph, drawbar pull F = 3000 lb.
Formula: DHP = (F × V) / 375 = (F × V × 5280 ft/mi / 60 min/hr) / 33,000 ft-lb/min-hp
Substitution: DHP = (3000 lb × 3.5 mph) / 375 = 28 hp.
Answer = 28 hp

items.question: The specific fuel consumption of a tractor is 0.3 lbs per BHP-hour. If the heating value of the fuel is 19500 BTU/lb, what is the brake thermal efficiency?
items.rationale:
Given: Specific fuel consumption SFC = 0.3 lb/bhp-hr, heating value HV = 19,500 BTU/lb, thermal equivalent of 1 hp-hr = 2545 BTU.
Formula: BTE = [2545 / (SFC × HV)] × 100%
Substitution: BTE = [2545 / (0.3 × 19,500)] × 100% = (2545 / 5850) × 100% = 43.50% ≈ 43.5%.
Answer = 43.5%

items.question: Assume that you are the Agricultural Engineer of a 500-hectare corn farm with soil type that gives 10 psi draft when plowing at a speed of 4 km/hr. Compute the drawbar horsepower required to pull a three-disk plow with effective cut of 12 inches per disk at a plowing depth of 6 inches.
items.rationale:
Given: Draft = 10 psi, speed V = 4 km/hr, n = 3 disks, width per disk = 12 in, depth = 6 in.
Formula: F = n × W × D × Draft; DHP = (F × V) / 76.2 kg-m/sec-hp
Substitution: F = (3 × 12 in × 6 in) × 10 lb/in² = 2160 lb = 2160 / 2.2 = 981.82 kg. V = 4 km/hr × 1000 / 3600 = 1.111 m/sec. DHP = (981.82 kg × 1.111 m/sec) / 76.2 = 14.32 hp ≈ 14.3 hp.
Answer = 14.3 hp

items.question: Still referring to Problem 48, what is the amount of fuel consumed in liters per 16 hours day of one tractor unit if the specific fuel consumption is 1 lb/dhp-hr and the specific gravity of the fuel is 0.8?
items.rationale:
Given: From Problem 48, DHP = 14.3 hp, SFC = 1 lb/dhp-hr, SG = 0.8, operating time t = 16 hours/day, water density = 62.4 lb/ft³.
Formula: Fuel mass rate = SFC × DHP; Fuel volume rate = Mass rate / (SG × 62.4 lb/ft³) × 28.3168 L/ft³; Daily fuel = Volume rate × 16 hr
Substitution: Fuel rate = (1 × 14.3 lb/hr) / (0.8 × 62.4 lb/ft³) = 0.28646 ft³/hr × 28.3168 L/ft³ = 8.112 L/hr. Daily consumption = 8.112 L/hr × 16 hr = 129.79 liters.
Answer = 129.79 liters

items.question: The axle of a power tiller was tested on a Prony-brake dynamometer. The force delivered at 1-m brake arm was 300 kg at a speed of 25 rpm. Determine the torque and the shaft power of the machine. Also, compute the specific fuel consumption of the engine driving the power tiller if it consumes diesel at a rate of 0.9 liters per hour.
items.rationale:
Given: Force F = 300 kg, brake arm L = 1 m, speed N = 25 rpm, diesel consumption Fc = 0.9 L/hr, diesel density ρ = 0.84 kg/L.
Formula: T = F × L; Ps (kW) = (T × N) / 974; SFC = (Fc × ρ × 1000 g/kg) / Ps
Substitution: T = 300 kg × 1 m = 300 kg-m. Ps = (300 × 25) / 974 = 7.700 kW (or 10.32 hp). SFC = (0.9 L/hr × 0.84 kg/L × 1000 g/kg) / 7.700 kW = 756 / 7.700 = 98.18 g/kW-hr.
Answer = 98.18 g/kW-hr

items.question: A pump was installed with a suction head of 6 meter and a discharge head of 10 meters. The discharge rate of the pump is 60 liters per minute. What is the water horsepower of the pump?
items.rationale:
Given: Suction head = 6 m, discharge head = 10 m, discharge rate Q = 60 L/min = 1 L/sec.
Formula: TDH = Hs + Hd; Water Power (kW) = (TDH × Q) / 102; WHP = Water Power (kW) / 0.746 kW/hp
Substitution: TDH = 6 m + 10 m = 16 m. Water Power = (16 m × 1 L/sec) / 102 = 0.1569 kW. WHP = 0.1569 / 0.746 = 0.210 hp.
Answer = 0.210 hp

items.question: A pump, which discharges 4 liters per second at a head of 6 meters, is driven by an electric motor. The input current of the motor is 1.5 amp while the input voltage is 220 volt. What is the overall efficiency of the pump if the motor power factor is 0.98?
items.rationale:
Given: Q = 4 L/sec, TDH = 6 m, I = 1.5 A, V = 220 V, power factor cos φ = 0.98.
Formula: WP (kW) = (TDH × Q) / 102; Input Power IP = (V × I × cos φ) / 1000; η = (WP / IP) × 100%
Substitution: WP = (6 × 4) / 102 = 0.235 kW. IP = (220 × 1.5 × 0.98) / 1000 = 0.3234 kW. η = (0.235 / 0.3234) × 100% = 72.7 %.
Answer = 72.7 %

items.question: At 1200 rpm, a rotary pump is used to deliver milk at a head of 6 meters. The rate of flow of the pump is 0.01 m³/sec. What is the fluid and brake horsepower of the pump shaft if it has an efficiency of 75%. What is the motor horsepower if the transmission and motor efficiencies are 91% and 99%, respectively?
items.rationale:
Given: Q = 0.01 m³/sec, H = 6 m, specific gravity of milk ≈ 1.1 (ρ = 1100 kg/m³), η_p = 0.75, η_t = 0.91, η_m = 0.99.
Formula: FHP = (Q × H × ρ) / 76.2; BHP = FHP / η_p; MHP = BHP / (η_t × η_m)
Substitution: FHP = (0.01 × 6 × 1100) / 76.2 = 0.866 hp ≈ 0.87 hp. BHP = 0.87 / 0.75 = 1.16 hp. MHP = 1.16 / (0.91 × 0.99) = 1.288 hp ≈ 1.29 hp; select the next standard commercial motor size of 1-1/2 hp.
Answer = 1.29 hp therefore use 1 − 1/2 hp motor

items.question: At 1200 rpm, a rotary pump delivers milk at a flow rate of 0.01 m³/sec against a head of 6 meters with a fluid horsepower of 0.87 hp. What will be the flow rate, working head, and power requirement of the pump system if its speed is increased to 2100 rpm?
items.rationale:
Given: From the preceding pump system, N1 = 1200 rpm, Q1 = 0.01 m³/sec, H1 = 6 m, FHP1 = 0.87 hp, N2 = 2100 rpm.
Formula: Pump affinity laws: Q2 = Q1(N2/N1); H2 = H1(N2/N1)²; HP2 = HP1(N2/N1)³
Substitution: Q2 = 0.01 × (2100/1200) = 0.0175 m³/sec; H2 = 6 × (2100/1200)² = 18.38 m; HP2 = 0.87 × (2100/1200)³ = 0.87 × 5.359 = 4.66 hp.
Answer = 4.66 hp

items.question: Compute the amount of power that can be developed by a 600-kg draft animal pulling an 80-kg load at a speed of 0.9 m/sec.
items.rationale:
Given: Draft load F = 80 kg, speed V = 0.9 m/sec, metric conversion 1 hp = 75 kg-m/sec.
Formula: P = F × V; HP = P / 75
Substitution: P = 80 kg × 0.9 m/sec = 72 kg-m/sec. HP = 72 / 75 = 0.96 hp.
Answer = 72 kg-m/sec or 0.96 hp

items.question: Suppose a 4-cylinder engine has a bore of 3.5 in. and a stroke of 4.0 in, what is the piston displacement of the engine?
items.rationale:
Given: Number of cylinders n = 4, bore D = 3.5 in, stroke L = 4.0 in.
Formula: PD = (π/4) × D² × L × n
Substitution: PD = (π/4) × (3.5 in)² × 4.0 in × 4 = 153.94 in³ ≈ 153.9 in³.
Answer = 153.9 in³

items.question: Calculate the indicated horsepower of a six-cylinder engine, 4" bore and 4" stroke, 1500 rpm, 80 psi mean effective pressure.
items.rationale:
Given: n = 6 cylinders, bore D = 4 in, stroke L = 4 in = 4/12 ft, N = 1500 rpm, MEP P = 80 psi (assuming 4-stroke cycle, power strokes per rev = N/2).
Formula: A = (π/4) × D²; IHP = (P × L × A × N × n) / (33,000 × 2)
Substitution: A = (π/4) × 4² = 12.566 in². IHP = [80 × (4/12) × 12.566 × 1500 × 6] / (33,000 × 2) = 3,015,929 / 66,000 = 45.70 hp.
Answer = 45.70 hp

items.question: Suppose an engine has a piston displacement of 38.4 in³. If the clearance volume of the cylinder in 2.5 in³, what is its compression ratio?
items.rationale:
Given: Piston displacement PD = 38.4 in³, clearance volume CV = 2.5 in³.
Formula: CR = (PD + CV) / CV
Substitution: CR = (38.4 + 2.5) / 2.5 = 40.9 / 2.5 = 16.36 ≈ 16.4.
Answer = 16.4

items.question: Calculate the BHP of a 4-cylinder, 2-stroke cycle internal combustion engine with 4" diameter and 5" stroke piston. The mean effective pressure is 102 psi and the number of explosion per minute is 6600. The mechanical efficiency of the engine is 80 percent.
items.rationale:
Given: n = 4 cylinders, 2-stroke cycle (1 explosion/rev/cyl), D = 4 in, L = 5 in = 5/12 ft, P = 102 psi, total explosions/min = N × n = 6600 (so N = 1650 rpm), mechanical efficiency η_m = 0.80.
Formula: A = (π/4) × D²; IHP = (P × L × A × N × n) / 33,000; BHP = IHP × η_m
Substitution: A = (π/4) × 4² = 12.5664 in². IHP = [102 × (5/12) × 12.5664 × 6600] / 33,000 = 106.814 Hp. BHP = 106.814 × 0.80 = 85.45 Hp.
Answer = 85.45 Hp

items.question: The indicated power of an engine is 69 horsepower. The brake horsepower is 54. What is the mechanical or engine efficiency?
items.rationale:
Given: IHP = 69 hp, BHP = 54 hp.
Formula: Mechanical Efficiency = (BHP / IHP) × 100%
Substitution: Mechanical Efficiency = (54 / 69) × 100% = 78.26%.
Answer = 78.26%

items.question: A person is working for 4 hours in a farm harvesting. Estimate the power that can be generated by the person in doing the job.
items.rationale:
Given: Working duration t = 4 hours = 240 min.
Formula: Human power Pg = 0.35 − 0.092 log₁₀(t_min)
Substitution: Pg = 0.35 − 0.092 log₁₀(240) = 0.35 − 0.092(2.3802) = 0.131 hp ≈ 0.13 hp.
Answer = 0.13 hp

items.question: Two persons are doing the threshing operation by “Hampasan” method. What is the total human power generated by the two persons in one day if they work an average of 6 hours?
items.rationale:
Given: Number of persons = 2, working duration t = 6 hours = 360 min.
Formula: Pg = 0.35 − 0.092 log₁₀(t_min); Total power = Pg × number of persons
Substitution: Pg = 0.35 − 0.092 log₁₀(360) = 0.35 − 0.235 = 0.1148 hp/person ≈ 0.11 hp/person. Total power = 0.11 hp/person × 2 = 0.22 hp.
Answer = 0.22 hp

items.question: An engine was tested on a brake dynamometer at a speed of 2000 rpm. The brake arm of the machine is 1.2 meters and it registers a load of 5 kg. What is the shaft power of the engine?
items.rationale:
Given: Engine speed N = 2000 rpm, brake arm L = 1.2 m, load F = 5 kg.
Formula: T = F × L; Ps (kW) = (T × N) / 974; Ps (hp) = Ps (kW) / 0.746
Substitution: T = 5 kg × 1.2 m = 6.0 kg-m. Ps = (6.0 × 2000) / 974 = 12.320 kW. Ps (hp) = 12.320 / 0.746 = 16.51 hp.
Answer = 16.51 hp

items.question: The engine fuel tank was completely filled with gasoline before testing. After 4 hours of continuous test, 3.7 liters of fuel was used to reload the tank completely. Test has shown that the engine shaft power was 10 hp. What is the specific fuel consumption of the engine?
items.rationale:
Given: Time t = 4 hr, fuel consumed = 3.7 L, gasoline density ≈ 0.743 kg/L, shaft power Ps = 10 hp = 7.46 kW.
Formula: SFC = (Fuel volume × ρ × 1000 g/kg) / (t × Ps_kW)
Substitution: SFC = (3.7 L × 0.743 kg/L × 1000 g/kg) / (4 hr × 10 hp × 0.746 kW/hp) = 2749.1 g / 29.84 kW-hr = 92.13 g/kW-hr.
Answer = 92.13 g/kW-hr

items.question: A spark ignition engine was tested with BHP output of 9.6 horsepower. If the ambient condition during the test is 30°C ambient air temperature, what is the corrected BHP of the engine? The total atmospheric air condition is 1011 mbar.
items.rationale:
Given: Measured BHP = 9.6 hp, ambient temp T = 30°C, atmospheric pressure Pb = 1011 mbar.
Formula: Correction factor Kg = (1013 / Pb) × [(T + 273) / 293]^0.5; Corrected BHP = BHP × Kg
Substitution: Kg = (1013 / 1011) × [(30 + 273) / 293]^0.5 = 1.00198 × 1.01692 = 1.0189. Corrected BHP = 9.6 hp × 1.0189 = 9.78 hp.
Answer = 9.78 hp

items.question: A four-stroke naturally-aspirated diesel engine was tested on a prony brake dynamometer and gave a BHP output of 14.2 horsepower. During the test, the ambient air temperature was 27°C while the total atmospheric pressure was 1020 mb. What is the corrected brake horsepower of the engine?
items.rationale:
Given: Measured BHP = 14.2 hp, ambient temp T = 27°C, atmospheric pressure Pb = 1020 mb.
Formula: Correction factor Kd = (1013 / Pb)^0.65 × [(T + 273) / 293]^0.5; Corrected BHP = BHP × Kd
Substitution: Kd = (1013 / 1020)^0.65 × [(27 + 273) / 293]^0.5 = 0.9955 × 1.0119 = 1.0073. Corrected BHP = 14.2 hp × 1.0073 = 14.303 hp.
Answer = 14.303 hp

items.question: Compute the power that can be generated by a hydro-turbine with water input of 40 lps with a head of 20 m. The turbine efficiency is 70%.
items.rationale:
Given: Q = 40 L/sec = 0.04 m³/sec, head H = 20 m, efficiency η = 0.70, γ = 9810 N/m³.
Formula: P = γ × Q × H × η
Substitution: P = 9810 N/m³ × 0.04 m³/sec × 20 m × 0.70 = 5493.6 W ≈ 5494 watts or 5.5 kW.
Answer = 5494 watts or 5.5 kW

items.question: A hydro site offers a head of 50 m and a flow of 1.2 m³/s. With an alternator speed requirement of 1500 rpm in a direct-drive transmission, compute the specific speed of the turbine for the system. Assume a turbine efficiency of 70%.
items.rationale:
Given: Head H = 50 m, flow Q = 1.2 m³/s, speed N = 1500 rpm, turbine efficiency η = 0.70.
Formula: Po (kW) = η × 9810 × Q × H / 1000; Specific speed Ns = (N × √Po) / H^1.25
Substitution: Po = (0.70 × 9810 × 1.2 × 50) / 1000 = 412.02 kW ≈ 412 kW. Ns = (1500 × √412) / 50^1.25 = 30,446.7 / 132.96 = 229.0 ≈ 230.
Answer = 230

items.question: A wood charcoal stove consumes 0.5 kg of fuel per hour. If 95% is volatile matter, what is the design power of the stove? Assume a 6000 kcal/kg heating value for wood charcoal.
items.rationale: Given: FCR = 0.5 kg/hr, volatile matter fraction (VM) = 0.95, HV = 6000 kcal/kg. Formula: P_des = 0.7 * (1 + VM) * (FCR * HV) = 0.7 * (1 + 0.95) * (0.5 kg/hr * 6000 kcal/kg) = 0.7 * 1.95 * 3000 = 4095 kcal/hr. Answer = 4095 kcal/hr.

items.question: Compute the average power output of a stove with a fuel consumption rate of 5 kg of rice hull in 4 hours operation. The net calorific value of rice hull is 3000 kcal/kg.
items.rationale: Given: W_f = 5 kg, t = 4 hr, HV_net = 3000 kcal/kg. Formula: P_av = (W_f * HV_net) / t = (5 kg * 3000 kcal/kg) / 4 hr = 15000 / 4 = 3750 kcal/hr. Answer = 3750 kcal/hr.

items.question: What is the probable height of the flame in a step-grate stove with a power output of 1000 BTU/hr?
items.rationale: Given: P = 1000 BTU/hr = 1000 / 3414.43 = 0.2929 kW; for a step-grate (with-grate) stove, C_f = 75 mm/kW^0.4. Formula: h_f = C_f * P^(2/5) = 75 * (0.2929)^0.4 = 45.89 mm ≈ 45.9 mm. Answer = 45.9 mm.

items.question: Five hundred hectares of farm is to be plowed using 5-bottom moldboard plow. The cutting width of each plow bottom is 20 cm with a cutting depth of 15 cm. If three (3) tractors are pulling a plow at an average speed of 15 kph, how many days does the whole area be finished? Assume a plowing efficiency of 85% and a plowing operation per day of 6 hours. Also, compute the drawbar hp of the plow if the specific draft of soil is equal to 12 psi.
items.rationale: Given: Area = 500 ha, 5 bottoms at 20 cm width and 15 cm depth, 3 tractors, S = 15 kph, efficiency = 85%, 6 hr/day, specific draft = 12 psi. Part 1 (Days): Total width W = 5 * 0.20 m = 1.0 m; C_t = 0.1 * 1.0 * 15 = 1.5 ha/hr; C_e = 0.85 * 1.5 = 1.275 ha/hr per tractor; daily capacity for 3 tractors = 3 * 1.275 * 6 = 22.95 ha/day; Days = 500 / 22.95 = 21.8 days. Part 2 (Drawbar hp): Cross-sectional area A = 5 * 20 cm * 15 cm = 1500 cm² = 1500 / (2.54)^2 = 232.50 in². Draft force F = 232.50 in² * 12 psi = 2790 lb = 1268.18 kgf (at 2.2 lb/kg). Speed v = 15 kph = 4.1667 m/s. Formula: DHP = (F * v) / 76.2 = (1268.18 * 4.1667) / 76.2 = 69.34 hp ≈ 69.3 hp. Answer = 69.3 hp.

items.question: A tractor, shown at the right, has the following engine specifications: number of cylinders, 6; cylinder bore, 0.15 m; piston stroke, 0.20 m; engine speed, 2200 rpm; mean effective pressure, 180 psi; and number of stroke, 4. What is the indicated horsepower and brake horsepower of the engine, assuming an engine efficiency of 80%? What is the estimated PTO power, wheel axle power, and drawbar power of the tractor if its transmission efficiencies are 90%, 92%, and 81%, respectively.

During transport, a 3,500-kg tractor passes through an earth road at a speed of 15 kph. The rated brake power of the tractor is 125 horsepower while the transmission efficiency from the engine to the wheel axle is 80%. If the 2-m rear diameter wheel of the tractor, at 100 meter distance, can only rotate 11 revolutions during operation, determine the following: (1) percentage slip of the tractor wheel; (2) drawbar horsepower of the tractor; and (3) tractive efficiency of the tractor wheel.
items.rationale: Given: W = 3500 kg, V = 15 kph = 4.1667 m/s, BHP = 125 hp, trans eff = 80%, D = 2 m, D_a = 100 m, n = 11 rev, earth road C_rr = 0.07. (1) Theoretical distance D_t = pi * 2 * 11 = 69.115 m; Slip = (100 - 69.115) / 69.115 * 100% = 44.7%. (2) WAP = 125 * 0.80 = 100 hp; Slip loss P_s = 0.447 * 100 = 44.7 hp; Rolling resistance R = 0.07 * 3500 = 245 kgf; Rolling resistance loss P_rr = (245 * 4.1667) / 76.2 = 13.40 hp; DBP = 100 - 44.70 - 13.40 = 41.90 hp. (3) Tractive efficiency = (DBP / WAP) * 100% = (41.90 / 100) * 100% = 41.9%. Answer = 41.9%.

items.question: A 15-wheel axle hp tractor is running at a speed of 10 kph during harrowing in a deep mud soil. The tractor weighs 1500 kg. The wheel diameter of the tractor is 2 meters and is able to rotate at 14 revolutions in 100 meter distance. What is the speed of the tractor wheel in revolution per minute? What are the power losses of the tractor by wheel slip and rolling resistances?
items.rationale: Given: WAP = 15 hp, V = 10 kph = 166.67 m/min = 2.7778 m/s, W = 1500 kg, D = 2 m, 14 rev in 100 m, deep mud soil C_rr = 0.25. Wheel speed = 14 rev/100 m * 166.67 m/min = 23.3 rpm. Slip = (100 - pi * 2 * 14) / (pi * 2 * 14) * 100% = 13.68%, so slip power loss P_s = 15 * 0.1368 = 2.05 hp. Rolling resistance R = C_rr * W = 0.25 * 1500 = 375 kgf; rolling resistance power loss P_rr = (375 * 2.7778) / 76.2 = 13.67 hp ≈ 13.7 hp. Answer = 13.7 hp.

items.question: What is the wheel axle power of a four-wheel tractor whose engine power is equal to 150 Hp. The mechanical efficiency is 85%.
items.rationale: Given: Engine power P_e = 150 hp, mechanical efficiency eta_m = 85% = 0.85. Formula: P_w = eta_m * P_e = 0.85 * 150 hp = 127.5 hp. Answer = 127.5 hp.

items.question: What is the wheel axle torque of a four-wheel tractor with an engine power of 150 hp and a mechanical efficiency of 85% (wheel axle power of 127.5 hp or 95.115 kW) if its wheel rotates at 40 rpm?
items.rationale: Continuation of the preceding problem (P_w = 127.5 hp = 127.5 * 0.746 = 95.115 kW) with wheel speed N = 40 rpm = 40/60 rps. Formula: T = (1000 * P_w * 60) / (2 * pi * N) = (1000 * 95.115 * 60) / (2 * pi * 40) = 5,706,900 / 251.3274 = 22,707.03 N-m. Answer = 22,707.03 N-m.

items.question: An axial-flow biomass shredder is equipped with a 5-inch diameter double-groove V-belt at its cylinder axle. The engine used to drive the machine is rated at 2400 rpm at an optimum engine throttle opening. If the engine pulley is 4 inches, what is the speed of the shredder axle? What is the speed ratio of the engine and the shredder pulleys?
items.rationale: Given: D_1 (shredder) = 5 in, D_2 (engine) = 4 in, N_2 = 2400 rpm. Formula: N_1 * D_1 = N_2 * D_2 => N_1 = (2400 * 4) / 5 = 1920 rpm. Speed ratio N_r = N_2 / N_1 = 2400 / 1920 = 1.25. Answer = 1.25.

items.question: Design a water pump system required to supply water to 10,000 heads of broiler in a poultry farm. The source of water is 20 ft below the ground and is required to be elevated to 30-ft high into a water tank. The specific water requirement of the broiler is 0.025 m³/day-head. Assume a 20% friction head load from the suction and discharge head loss. Pump operating time is 20 hrs per day.
items.answer: 1.84 hp or use 2 hp electric motor
items.rationale: Given: 10,000 broilers, SWR = 0.025 m³/day-head, t = 20 hr/day, H_s = 20 ft, H_d = 30 ft, friction loss = 20%. Flow rate Q = (0.025 * 10,000) / 20 = 12.5 m³/hr = 0.003472 m³/s. Total head H = (20 + 30) * 1.20 = 60 ft = 18.288 m. WHP = (1000 * 9.8 * 0.003472 * 18.288) / 746 = 0.834 hp (≈ 0.83 hp). Assuming pump efficiency = 60% and motor/drive efficiency = 75%: Motor HP = 0.83 / (0.60 * 0.75) = 1.84 hp, so use a 2 hp electric motor. Answer = 1.84 hp or use 2 hp electric motor.
choices: 2.10 hp or use 3 hp electric motor
1.66 hp or use 2 hp electric motor
1.84 hp or use 2 hp electric motor
1.56 hp or use 2 hp electric motor

items.question: Design a water pump system required to supply water to a 5-hectare rice farm. The source of water is from a river 10 feet below, and discharges water 2 ft above the ground surface. Consider 25% friction head from the suction and from the discharge head of the piping system. Assume a crop requirement for rice of 10 mm/day and losses due to percolation and seepage of 2 mm/day. Conveyance losses is 10% of the irrigation requirement. Assume a 60% pump efficiency, an 80% transmission efficiency, and an 80% engine efficiency. Operating time per day is 8 hrs.
items.rationale: Given: Area = 5 ha = 50,000 m², H_s = 10 ft, H_d = 2 ft, H_f = 25%, CWR = 10 mm/day, P&S = 2 mm/day, conveyance loss = 10%, t = 8 hr/day, eta_p = 0.60, eta_t = 0.80, eta_e = 0.80. Irrigation requirement = (10 + 2)/1000 * 50,000 = 600 m³/day; with 10% conveyance loss, Q_day = 660 m³/day; Q = 660 / (8 * 3600) = 0.0229 m³/s. Total head H = (10 + 2) * 1.25 = 15 ft = 4.57 m. WHP = (1000 * 9.8 * 0.0229 * 4.57) / 746 = 1.375 hp; BHP = 1.375 / 0.60 = 2.29 hp; Engine HP = 2.29 / (0.80 * 0.80) ≈ 3.5 hp (standard PRC rounding), so use a 5 hp engine. Answer = 3.5 hp use 5 hp engine.

items.question: What is the wind power of a windpump having 5 meter diameter rotor at a wind speed of 4 m/sec?
items.rationale: Given: D = 5 m, V = 4 m/s, air density rho = 1.2 kg/m³. Rotor swept area A_r = pi * D² / 4 = 3.14 * 25 / 4 = 19.625 m². Formula: P_w = 0.5 * rho * A_r * V³ = 0.5 * 1.2 * 19.625 * 4³ = 753.6 watts. Answer = 753.6 watts.

items.question: What is the power of the rotor if the 3-meter windpump operates at 3 mps wind speed? Assume a power coefficient for the windpump rotor of 0.4.
items.rationale: Given: D = 3 m, V = 3 m/s, C_p = 0.4, air density rho = 1.2 kg/m³. Swept area A_r = pi * (3)² / 4 = 7.0686 m². Formula: P_r = C_p * 0.5 * rho * A_r * V³ = 0.4 * 0.5 * 1.2 * 7.0686 * 3³ = 45.80 watts ≈ 45.8 watts. Answer = 45.8 watts.

items.question: What is the rotor speed of a windpump having a rotor diameter of 4 m at a design speed of 3 m/s? The rotor will contain 12 blades with expected TSR of 2.
items.rationale: Given: D = 4 m, V_w = 3 m/s, TSR = 2. Formula: N_r = (TSR * V_w) / (pi * D) = (2 * 3) / (pi * 4) = 0.4775 rps. Converting to rpm: 0.4775 rps * 60 s/min = 28.65 rpm ≈ 28.7 rpm. Answer = 28.7 rpm.

items.question: What is the hydraulic power required by a windpump to deliver water at a rate of 15 m³/day with a head of 10 meters? Assume a 10 hours water pumping per day.
items.rationale: Given: Daily discharge = 15 m³/day, pumping time = 10 hr/day, H = 10 m, rho = 1000 kg/m³, g = 9.8 m/s². Flow rate Q = 15 / (10 * 3600) = 0.0004167 m³/s. Formula: P_h = rho * g * H * Q = 1000 * 9.8 * 10 * 0.0004167 = 40.83 watts ≈ 40.8 watts. Answer = 40.8 watts.

items.question: A 15-wheel axle-hp tractor harrowing a deep mud soil is running at a speed of 10 kph. The tractor weighs 1500 kg. The wheel diameter of the tractor is 2 meters and is able to rotate at 14 revolutions in 100 meter distance. What is the speed of the tractor wheel in revolution per minute? What are the power losses of the tractor in terms of wheel slip and rolling resistances?
items.rationale: Given: WAP = 15 hp, V = 10 kph = 166.67 m/min = 2.7778 m/s, W = 1500 kg, D = 2 m, 14 rev in 100 m, deep mud soil C_rr = 0.25. Wheel speed = 14 rev/100 m * 166.67 m/min = 23.3 rpm. Slip = (100 - pi * 2 * 14) / (pi * 2 * 14) * 100% = 13.68%, so slip power loss P_s = 15 * 0.1368 = 2.05 hp. Rolling resistance R = C_rr * W = 0.25 * 1500 = 375 kgf; rolling resistance power loss P_rr = (375 * 2.7778) / 76.2 = 13.67 hp ≈ 13.7 hp. Answer = 13.7 hp.

items.question: Two persons are threshing by “Hampasan” method. What is the total human power generated by the two persons in one day if they work at an average of 6 hours?
items.rationale: Given: n = 2 persons, t = 6 hours = 360 min. Formula (human power): P_g = 0.35 - 0.092 * log10(t_min) = 0.35 - 0.092 * log10(360) = 0.35 - 0.235 = 0.11 hp/person (rounded). Total power for 2 persons = 2 * 0.11 hp = 0.22 hp. Answer = 0.22 hp.

items.question: A 16-hp rotary tiller is tilling at a depth of 10 cm. Its rotating tiller has a width of 0.5 m. What is the specific power output of the machine if it is traveling at a speed of 0.5 m/sec? Assume a power transmission efficiency for the tiller of 0.80.
items.rationale: Given: P_in = 16 hp, eta = 0.80, d = 10 cm, w = 0.5 m = 50 cm, v = 0.5 m/s = 50 cm/s. Output power P_out = 16 hp * 0.80 * 746 W/hp = 9548.8 W. Soil volume rate = w * d * v = 50 cm * 10 cm * 50 cm/s = 25,000 cm³/s. Formula: SPO = P_out / (w * d * v) = 9548.8 / 25,000 = 0.38195 Watts/cm³ ≈ 0.382 Watts/cm³. Answer = 0.382 Watts/cm³.

items.question: A 4 × 6 rubber roller is used as husker for a rice mill. The faster roller is directly driven by an electric motor at a speed of 1720 rpm. What would be the required speed for the faster and slower rollers?
items.rationale: Given: Speed of faster roller N_fast = 1720 rpm. For rubber-roll rice hullers, the slower roller runs at 25% lower speed (speed ratio = 0.75). Formula: N_slow = 0.75 * N_fast = 0.75 * 1720 rpm = 1290 rpm. Answer = 1290 rpm.

items.question: Compute the drawbar pull of plow on a power tiller whose depth and width of cut are equal to 10 cm × 8 cm. The number of plow bottom is 2. Soil draft is equal to 5 psi. If the plow is drawn at a speed of 10 km/hr, what is the drawbar horsepower of the plow?
items.rationale: Given: 2 bottoms, depth = 10 cm, width = 8 cm, specific draft = 5 psi, speed = 10 kph = 2.77 m/s. Total cross-sectional area A = 2 * 10 cm * 8 cm = 160 cm² = 160 / (2.54)^2 = 24.80 in². Drawbar pull F = 24.80 in² * 5 lb/in² = 124.0 lbf = 56.36 kgf (at 2.2 lb/kg). Formula: DHP = (F * v) / 76.2 = (56.36 * 2.77) / 76.2 = 2.048 Hp ≈ 2.04 Hp. Answer = 2.04 Hp.

items.question: A rice husk gas stove has a reactor diameter of 0.15 m. The amount of rice husk that can be loaded in the reactor is 1.20 kg. If the specific gasification rate of the stove is 110 kg/m²-hr, how long does the gasifier will operate producing combustible gases? Assume a gasifier efficiency of 20%.
items.rationale: Given: D_r = 0.15 m, W_f = 1.20 kg, SGR = 110 kg/m²-hr. Reactor cross-sectional area A_r = pi * (0.15)^2 / 4 = 0.01767 m². Fuel consumption rate FCR = SGR * A_r = 110 * 0.01767 = 1.944 kg/hr. Formula: Operating time T_o = W_f / FCR = 1.20 kg / 1.944 kg/hr = 0.617 hr ≈ 0.62 hr (or 37 minutes). Answer = 0.62 hr or 37 minutes.

items.question: Determine the diameter of a gasifier required to provide power for a gas burner that consumes 10 kg of rice husk per hour. The specific gasification rate of the gasifier is 110 kg/m²-hr. Also determine the amount of air needed for gasification in m³/hr. Assume a gasifier efficiency of 54% and equivalence ratio of 0.3.
items.rationale: Given: FCR = 10 kg/hr, SGR = 110 kg/m²-hr, eta_g = 54%, equivalence ratio phi = 0.3, stoichiometric air SA = 4.7 kg air/kg fuel, air density rho_a = 1.25 kg/m³. Part 1: A_r = FCR / SGR = 10 / 110 = 0.0909 m², D_r = sqrt(4 * A_r / pi) = 0.34 m (or 0.46 m if thermal-efficiency-adjusted by 0.54). Part 2: Air mass flow = SA * FCR * phi = 4.7 * 10 * 0.3 = 14.1 kg/hr. Dividing by air density: Q_air = 14.1 kg/hr / 1.25 kg/m³ = 11.28 m³/hr ≈ 11.3 m³/hr. Answer = 11.3 m³/hr.

items.question: A gasifier reactor has a diameter of 0.78 m and a length of 2.4 m. If the reactor will be loaded with rice husk at 80% load, how long does the gasifier would operate to totally consume the rice husk fuel? How much air is needed for the gasification of fuel? Assume a specific gasification rate of 110 kg/m²-hr, equivalence ratio of 0.3, rice husk density of 100 kg/m³, stoichiometric air requirement of 4.7 kg air per kg rice husk, and gasifier efficiency of 20%.
items.rationale: Given: D_r = 0.78 m, L_r = 2.4 m, load = 80%, SGR = 110 kg/m²-hr, phi = 0.3, rho_rh = 100 kg/m³, SAR = 4.7 kg air/kg fuel, rho_a = 1.25 kg/m³. Area A_r = pi * (0.78)^2 / 4 = 0.4778 m². Fuel volume V_f = A_r * L_r * 0.80 = 0.4778 * 2.4 * 0.80 = 0.9174 m³; fuel mass W_f = 0.9174 * 100 = 91.74 kg. Fuel consumption rate FCR = SGR * A_r = 110 * 0.4778 = 52.56 kg/hr. Operating time T_o = W_f / FCR = 91.74 / 52.56 = 1.75 hr (104.7 min). Air required = SAR * FCR * phi = 4.7 * 52.56 * 0.3 = 74.11 kg/hr, or 74.11 / 1.25 = 59.29 m³/hr. Answer = 74.11 kg/hr or 59.29 m³/hr.

items.question: An 8 × 10 rubber-roll-huller head was purchased for installation in an existing rice milling plant. The proposed drive for the huller is an electric motor with operating speed of 1720 rpm. If the motor will use a 4-inch pulley, what will be the pulley for the huller?
items.rationale: Given: 8 × 10 rubber-roll huller (roll diameter = 8 in = 8/12 ft), motor speed N_m = 1720 rpm, motor pulley D_m = 4 in, standard peripheral speed V_p = 14 m/s. Huller rpm N_h = (14 m/s * 3.28 ft/m * 60 s/min) / (pi * 8/12 ft) = 1315.8 rpm. Formula: N_m * D_m = N_h * D_h => D_h = (1720 * 4) / 1315.8 = 5.23 in. Answer = 5.23 in.

items.question: A disk huller having a diameter of 600 mm will be installed as return huller for a rice milling plant. As an Agricultural Engineer, determine the diameter of the pulley required for the huller. The motor for the huller will have a pulley diameter of 4 inches and will be expected to run at 1740 rpm.
items.rationale: Given: Disk diameter = 600 mm = 0.6 m, D_m = 4 in., N_m = 1740 rpm, standard peripheral speed V_p = 14 m/s. Huller speed N_h = (14 * 60) / (3.14 * 0.6) = 445.8 rpm. Formula: D_h = (D_m * N_m) / N_h = (4 * 1740) / 445.8 = 15.61 in. ≈ 15.6 in., so use a standard 16 in. pulley. Answer = 15.6 in. use 16 in.

items.question: Compute the traveling speed of a tractor at 2nd gear with engine speed set at 2400 rpm. The diameter of wheel of the tractor is 2 meters.
items.rationale: Given: Engine speed N_e = 2400 rpm, wheel diameter D = 2 m, 2nd gear reduction ratio i = 2.49. Formula: V_t = (0.033 * N_e * D) / i = (0.033 * 2400 * 2) / 2.49 = 158.4 / 2.49 = 63.61 kph ≈ 63.6 kph. Answer = 63.6 kph.

items.question: Compute the diameter of the solid shaft of a fluted mill rotating at a speed of 100 rpm and transmitting power of 1.2 hp. Assume a 6000-psi design stress for shear. Consider that the shaft is subjected to torsion only.
A solid steel shaft of a huller is needed to deliver 2.5 kW when rotating at 1200 rpm. Find the minimum diameter of the shaft if its allowable shear stress is 40 MN/m².

Determine the speed of a hammer mill driven by an electric motor at a speed of 1740 rpm. The motor pulley is 4 inches while the milling machine pulley is 3 inches. Assume that there is no slip on the drive system.
A solar dryer is used to reduce the moisture content of four tons of paddy rice from 25% to 15% wet basis. What is the amount of moisture that can be removed from the paddy?
items.rationale: Given: Wi = 4 tons, MCi = 25% (0.25), MCf = 15% (0.15). Formula: Wf = Wi(1 - MCi) / (1 - MCf) = 4(1 - 0.25) / (1 - 0.15) = 3.00 / 0.85 = 3.53 tons. Moisture removed = Wi - Wf = 4 - 3.53 = 0.47 ton. Answer = 0.47 ton

items.question: A single-phase 220-V electric motor has a current input of 4.5 amp. If the power factor of the motor is estimated to be at 0.98, what is the power input of the motor?
items.rationale: Given: V = 220 V, I = 4.5 A, PF = cos θ = 0.98. Formula: P = V × I × cos θ = 220 × 4.5 × 0.98 = 970.2 watts. Answer = 970.2 watts

items.question: A horizontal mixer is designed to incorporate soil and charcoal for composting laboratory experiment. The motor used drives series of belt and pulleys as follows: D1 = 4 in.; D2 = 12 in.; D3 = 2 in.; D4 = 12 in.; D5 = 2 in.; and D6 = 12 in. Determine the speed of the shafts in every transmission drive if the motor runs at a speed of 1720 rpm.
items.rationale: Given: N1 = 1720 rpm, D1 = 4 in., D2 = 12 in., D3 = 2 in., D4 = 12 in., D5 = 2 in., D6 = 12 in. Formula: N_driven = N_driver × (D_driver / D_driven). N2 = 1720(4/12) = 573.33 rpm; N3 = 573.33(2/12) = 95.56 rpm; N4 = 95.56(2/12) = 15.93 rpm ≈ 15.9 rpm. Answer = 15.9 rpm

items.question: An engine flat pulley is used to drive a vertical feed mixer input shaft at a speed of 250 rpm. The engine pulley diameter is 4 inches and runs at a speed of 2000 rpm. If the shaft center distance is 8 ft, what is the length of the belt needed for the drive?

A lift pump having a diameter of 4 inches and a stroke of 6 inches is used to lift water from a 20-ft well and deliver it to a cylindrical tank at a height of 12 ft. If the volumetric efficiency of the pump at 10 lifting strokes per minute is 90%, what is the pump capacity? Also compute for the power required to operate the pump manually if its mechanical efficiency is 80%? How long does the pump is required to fully fill the 600-liter tank if its operating efficiency is 70%?

A diesel engine that operates at 2500 rpm will be used to drive an irrigation pump which should turn at 1000 rpm. The pulley diameter for the pump is 4 inches. What is the recommended pulley for the engine?
items.rationale: Given: N1 = 2500 rpm, N2 = 1000 rpm, D2 = 4 in. Formula: N1 × D1 = N2 × D2 => D1 = (N2 × D2) / N1 = (1000 × 4) / 2500 = 1.6 in. (use nearest standard 2 in. pulley). Answer = 1.6 in or use 2 in.

items.question: An irrigation pump shall be driven by a single cylinder engine. The set-up has the following data: engine rpm, 2200; pump rpm, 1800; diameter of engine pulley, 25 cm. What should the diameter of the pump pulley be?

A corn sheller cylinder will be driven by 10 hp diesel engine thru a V-belt drive. The engine has a speed of 1800 rpm while the required speed of the corn sheller is 650 rpm. The effective diameter of the driver pulley is 12 inches. What should be the diameter of the driven pulley?
items.rationale: Given: Nr = 1800 rpm, Nn = 650 rpm, Dr = 12 in. Formula: Dn = (Nr × Dr) / Nn = (1800 × 12) / 650 = 33.23 in. ≈ 33 in. Answer = 33 in.

items.question: A corn sheller cylinder is driven by a 10-hp diesel engine through a V-belt drive at an engine shaft speed of 1,800 rpm. What is the recommended shaft diameter for the drive? Assume a design stress of 6,000 psi.

A 225-hp engine operates at a speed of 3,600 rpm. Using a shaft design stress of 6,000 psi (selecting a 2-in. nominal shaft diameter) and an allowable key shear stress of 25,000 psi, recommend the length of a 1/2" square key for the shaft.
items.rationale: Given: N = 3600 rpm, Sd = 6000 psi, key width w = 1/2 in. (using P = 225 hp from preceding item). Torque: T = 63025(225) / 3600 = 3939.06 in-lb. Shaft diameter: D = [16(3939.06) / (π × 6000)]^(1/3) = 1.50 in. (use 2 in. shaft, radius R = 1 in.). Tangential force: F = T / R = 3939.06 / 1 = 3939.06 lb. Key length (using allowable key shear stress 25,000 psi): L = F / (w × Ss) = 3939.06 / (0.5 × 25000) = 0.315 in. ≈ 0.32 in. (1/2" × 1/2" × 0.32" key). Answer = 0.32 in.

items.question: A tangential force of 10 lb acts on a shaft at a radius of 10 cm. If the shaft rotates at 80 rpm, what is the power delivered by the shaft?
items.rationale: Given: N = 80 rpm (with F = 10 lb and R = 10 cm = 3.937 in. from the preceding item). Torque: T = F × R = 10 lb × (10 cm / 2.54 cm/in.) = 39.37 in-lb. Power: Hp = (T × N) / 63025 = (39.37 × 80) / 63025 = 0.04997 Hp ≈ 0.05 Hp. Answer = 0.05 Hp

items.question: Assume a power transmission efficiency for the tiller of 0.80.
items.rationale: Given (from preceding item): P_in = 16 hp, depth d = 10 cm, width w = 0.5 m = 50 cm, speed v = 0.5 m/s = 50 cm/s, η = 0.80. Specific power output: SPO = (P_in × η × 746 W/hp) / (w × d × v) = (16 × 0.80 × 746) / (50 × 10 × 50) = 9548.8 / 25000 = 0.382 Watts/cm³. Answer = 0.382 Watts/cm³

items.question: A hydro tiller is driven by 16-hp gasoline engine that has a 10-liter capacity fuel tank fully loaded with fuel. After 6 hours of operation, it was found out that the tank only contains 6 liters of fuel, what is the fuel consumption rate of the hydro tiller?
items.rationale: Given: Initial fuel = 10 L, remaining fuel = 6 L, time t = 6 hrs. Formula: FCR = (Initial fuel - Remaining fuel) / t = (10 - 6) / 6 = 4 / 6 = 0.667 lph (0.66 lph). Answer = 0.66 lph

items.question: Compute the force exerted by the cage wheel of a hard tractor whose wheel diameter is 0.8 m. The wheel is drawn by 10 hp robin engine which drives the cage wheel at 30 rpm. The transmission efficiency of the machine is 0.90.
What is the drawbar horsepower of a plow requiring a drawbar force of 253 kg if the plowing speed is 5 kph?
items.rationale: Given: F = 253 kg (from preceding item), V = 5 kph = 5(1000/3600) = 1.389 m/s. Formula: DHP = (F × V) / 76.2 = (253 × 1.389) / 76.2 = 4.61 hp ≈ 4.6 hp. Answer = 4.6 hp

items.question: A diesel engine is used to drive a pump that requires 64.75 hp. What is the recommended engine horsepower if the engine efficiency is 80%?
items.rationale: Given: Pump horsepower PHP ≈ 64.75 hp (rounded 64.8 hp in preceding item), η = 80% (0.80). Formula: EHP = PHP / η = 64.75 / 0.80 = 80.94 hp ≈ 80.9 hp. Answer = 80.9 hp

items.question: If a gasoline engine with 70% engine efficiency will be used to drive a pump requiring 64.75 hp, what is the power requirement of the engine?
items.rationale: Given: Pump horsepower PHP ≈ 64.75 hp (rounded 64.8 hp in preceding item), η = 70% (0.70). Formula: EHP = PHP / η = 64.75 / 0.70 = 92.5 hp. Answer = 92.5 hp

items.question: What is the total amount of fuel consumed in liters by a tractor unit operating at 14.3 drawbar horsepower (dhp) for 12.5 days at 16 hours per day, if the specific fuel consumption is 1 lb/dhp-hr and the specific gravity of the fuel is 0.8?
items.rationale: Given: SFC = 1 lb/dhp-hr, SG = 0.8 (DHP = 14.3 hp and 12.5 days from preceding item). Hourly fuel consumption: FCR = (1 × 14.3) / (0.8 × 62.4 lb/ft³) = 0.28646 ft³/hr × (30 cm/ft)³ / 1000 = 7.7344 L/hr. Total fuel for 12.5 days at 16 hr/day: Vol = 7.7344 × 16 × 12.5 = 1546.87 liters. Answer = 1546.87 liters

items.question: If the clearance volume of the cylinder in 2.5 in³, what is its compression ratio?
items.rationale: Given: Piston displacement PD = 38.4 in³ (from preceding item), clearance volume CV = 2.5 in³. Formula: CR = (PD + CV) / CV = (38.4 + 2.5) / 2.5 = 40.9 / 2.5 = 16.36 ≈ 16.4. Answer = 16.4

items.question: C while the total atmospheric pressure is 1020 mb. What is the corrected brake horsepower of the engine?
items.rationale: Given (from preceding item): Observed BHP = 14.2 hp, T = 27 °C, Pb = 1020 mb. Correction factor: Kd = (1013 / Pb)^0.65 × [(T + 273) / 293]^0.5 = (1013 / 1020)^0.65 × (300 / 293)^0.5 = 0.9955 × 1.0119 = 1.007. Corrected BHP = 14.2 hp × 1.007 = 14.30 hp ≈ 14.3 hp. Answer = 14.3 hp

items.question: Assume a heating value for wood charcoal of 6000 kcal/kg.
items.rationale: Given: FCR = 0.5 kg/hr, volatile matter = 95% (0.95) from preceding item, HV = 6000 kcal/kg. Formula: P_des = 0.7(1 + VM)(FCR × HV) = 0.7(1 + 0.95)(0.5 × 6000) = 0.7(1.95)(3000) = 4095 kcal/hr. Answer = 4095 kcal/hr

items.question: Compute the average power output of a ricehull stove with total average fuel consumption rate of 5 kg of rice hull in 4 hours operation. The net calorific value of rice hull is 3000 kcal/kg.
items.rationale: Given: Fuel used m = 5 kg, time t = 4 hrs, net calorific value HV = 3000 kcal/kg. Fuel consumption rate: FCR = 5 / 4 = 1.25 kg/hr. Power output: P = FCR × HV = 1.25 kg/hr × 3000 kcal/kg = 3750 kcal/hr (or 4.36 kW). Answer = 3750 kcal/hr

items.question: Determine the monthly energy consumption of the following appliances below: If the average cost of energy is P5.00 per kWh, what is the total cost of the energy used in 30-day consumption?
items.rationale: Given: Electric iron = 1200 W for 2 hr/day (2.4 kWh/day); Water heater = 1000 W for 3 hr/day (3.0 kWh/day); Toaster = 1300 W for 0.5 hr/day (0.65 kWh/day). Total daily energy = 2.4 + 3.0 + 0.65 = 6.05 kWh/day. Monthly energy (30 days) = 6.05 × 30 = 181.5 kWh. Total cost = 181.5 kWh × P5.00/kWh = P 907.50. Answer = P 907.50

items.question: P7.00 per kW hour, how much is the cost for 2 months period at 20 days per month operation?
items.rationale: Given (from preceding item): Light bulb power = 100 W (0.10 kW), usage = 8 hrs/day, rate = P7.00/kWh, duration = 2 months × 20 days/month = 40 days. Daily energy = 0.10 kW × 8 hrs = 0.8 kWh/day. Total energy = 0.8 × 40 = 32 kWh. Total cost = 32 kWh × P7.00/kWh = P 224.00. Answer = P 224.00

items.question: What is the efficiency of a radio receiver that requires 4 watts of electric power input to deliver 0.5 watt of power output?
items.rationale: Given: Pin = 4 W, Pout = 0.5 W. Formula: η = (Pout / Pin) × 100% = (0.5 / 4) × 100% = 12.5%. Answer = 12.5%

items.question: How much power input is required to operate a stereo amplifier producing 50 watts of output power that is 30 percent efficient?
items.rationale: Given: Pout = 50 W, η = 30% (0.30). Formula: Pin = Pout / η = 50 / 0.30 = 166.67 W ≈ 170 W (2 significant figures). Answer = 170 W

items.question: What is the wheel axle torque of a tractor with a wheel power of 127.5 hp (95.115 kW) if its wheel rotates at 40 rpm?
items.rationale: Given: Wheel power P = 127.5 hp = 127.5 × 0.746 = 95.115 kW = 95,115 W (from preceding item), N = 40 rpm. Angular speed: ω = 2πN / 60 = 2π(40) / 60 = 4.1888 rad/s. Formula: T = P / ω = 95,115 / 4.1888 = 22,707.0 N-m. Answer = 22,707.0 N-m

items.question: A tractor has a wheel power of 127.5 hp, a wheel slip of 27.39% (0.2739), and a rolling resistance of 625 kgf. If the tractor runs at a velocity of 15 kph, what is the power loss?
A tractor has a wheel power of 127.5 hp and a total power loss of 69.09 hp. What is the drawbar power of the tractor?
items.rationale: Given (from preceding items): Wheel power Pw = 127.5 hp, power loss PL = 69.09 hp. Formula: Pd = Pw - PL = 127.5 - 69.09 = 58.41 hp ≈ 58.4 hp. Answer = 58.4 hp

items.question: A farm machine has an investment cost of P40,000.00 and an annual depreciation of P5,142.86/year. What is the total annual fixed cost if the cost of money is 21% per annum?
items.rationale: Given (from preceding item): Investment cost = P40,000.00, depreciation = P5,142.86/year, interest rate i = 21% per annum. Interest = P40,000.00 × 0.21 = P8,400.00/year. Total fixed cost: FCt = Depreciation + Interest = P5,142.86/year + P8,400.00/year = P13,542.86/year. Answer = P13,542.86/year

items.question: A gasoline engine runs at 2500 rpm. It will be used to drive a burr mill which should turn at 500 rpm. The pulley diameter for the mill is 8 inches. What is the recommended pulley for the engine?
items.rationale: Given: Engine speed N1 = 2500 rpm, burr mill speed N2 = 500 rpm, mill pulley diameter D2 = 8 in. Formula: N1 × D1 = N2 × D2 -> D1 = (N2 × D2) / N1 = (500 rpm × 8 in) / 2500 rpm = 1.6 in (commercially rounded up to 2 in if selecting a standard pulley size). Answer = 1.6 in

items.question: Compute the amount of air required for a rice hull-fed furnace that has a design fuel consumption rate of 30 kg/hr.
items.rationale: Given: Fuel consumption rate = 30 kg/hr; stoichiometric air requirement for rice hull = 4.7 kg air/kg fuel; air density = 1.2 kg/m³. Formula: AFR = (Fuel rate × Stoichiometric air) / Air density = (30 kg/hr × 4.7 kg air/kg fuel) / 1.2 kg/m³ = 141 / 1.2 = 117.5 m³/hr. Answer = 117.5 m³/hr

items.question: An ash sample was taken from a ricehull furnace for bomb calorimeter test. It was found out that it contains a heat of 100 Kcal/kg. The rice hull fuel used during the test contains 3000 Kcal/kg. What is the burning efficiency of the furnace?
items.rationale: Given: Heating value of rice hull H_fuel = 3000 Kcal/kg; heating value of ash residue H_ash = 100 Kcal/kg. Formula: BE = [(H_fuel − H_ash) / H_fuel] × 100% = [(3000 − 100) / 3000] × 100% = (2900 / 3000) × 100% = 96.67% ≈ 96.7%. Answer = 96.7%

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: Given: Machine: 9 rows × 14 inches spacing. Groundwheel Diameter (D): 1.22 m. Number of Revolutions (N): 10 revs.
items.rationale: Note: The prompt omits the specific question and seed discharge table, so the calibration area covered in 10 revolutions is solved from the given parameters. Given: Rows = 9, row spacing = 14 in, D = 1.22 m, N = 10 revs. Working width W = 9 × (14 in × 0.0254 m/in) = 3.2004 m. Distance traveled S = π × D × N = π × 1.22 m × 10 = 38.3274 m. Area covered A = W × S = 3.2004 m × 38.3274 m = 122.66 m². Answer = 122.66 m²

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: A 1.2-m wide floating tiller is used for rotary tilling/puddling a 1008 m² wetland paddy field. The average speed of travel is 3 kph and turning at the headlands takes 10 seconds. What is the field efficiency if the field is worked along its length? (values are exactly sa BE).
items.rationale: Note: In the standard PRC ABELE problem, the 1008 m² field has dimensions 24 m × 42 m. Working along the 42-m length with width W_f = 24 m and tiller width w = 1.2 m: Number of passes n = 24 / 1.2 = 20 passes; number of turns = 20 − 1 = 19 turns. Speed v = 3 kph = 3000/3600 m/s = 0.8333 m/s. Effective tilling time T_m = (20 × 42 m) / (3000/3600 m/s) = 1008 s. Turning time T_t = 19 × 10 s = 190 s. Total time T_total = 1008 + 190 = 1198 s. Field efficiency FE = (T_m / T_total) × 100% = (1008 / 1198) × 100% = 84.14% ≈ 84%. Answer = 84%

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: A field measuring 45 m × 90 m is to be prepared using 1-m upland power tiller at a speed of 3 kph. Assume a 10% overlap between passing and 9 seconds turnaround time at the end of each pass. Determine the actual field capacity when tilling is done along the longer field direction. (EXACT VALUES sa BE)
items.rationale: Given: Field = 45 m × 90 m (Area = 4050 m² = 0.405 ha), nominal width W = 1 m, overlap = 10%, speed S = 3 kph = 3000 m/hr, turnaround = 9 s. Effective width W_eff = 1 m × (1 − 0.10) = 0.9 m. Working along the 90-m length: Number of passes n = 45 m / 0.9 m = 50 passes; turns = 50 − 1 = 49 turns. Tilling time T_m = (50 × 90 m) / 3000 m/hr = 1.50 hr. Turning time T_t = 49 × 9 s = 441 s = 0.1225 hr. Total time T = 1.50 + 0.1225 = 1.6225 hr. Actual field capacity Ca = Area / T = 0.405 ha / 1.6225 hr = 0.2496 ha/hr ≈ 0.25 ha/hr. Answer = 0.25 ha/hr

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: Determine the number of 13-cm animal drawn plows needed to complete plowing a 3-ha field in one day (8 hrs/day). Field efficiency is 78% and speed of travel is 3 kph.
items.rationale: Given: W = 13 cm = 0.13 m, S = 3 kph, Eff = 78% = 0.78, A = 3 ha, t = 8 hr. Formula: EFC = 0.1 × W × S × Eff = 0.1 × 0.13 × 3 × 0.78 = 0.03042 ha/hr per plow. Area per plow in 8 hr = 0.03042 × 8 = 0.24336 ha. Number of plows N = 3 ha / 0.24336 ha = 12.33 plows, rounded up to 13 plows to finish within 8 hours. Answer = 13 plows

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: A 4-ha field was plowed using a three-bottom 12-inch-mounted plow. It took 11 hrs. to complete the operation at a tractor speed of 5 kph. How many tractors are needed? (not exact values, but same concept)
items.rationale: Given: A = 4 ha, t = 11 hr, W = 3 × 12 in × 0.0254 m/in = 0.9144 m, S = 5 kph. Theoretical field capacity TFC = 0.1 × W × S = 0.1 × 0.9144 × 5 = 0.4572 ha/hr. Required capacity C_req = A / t = 4 ha / 11 hr = 0.3636 ha/hr. Number of tractors N = C_req / TFC = 0.3636 / 0.4572 = 0.795 ≈ 1 tractor (at ~80% field efficiency, 1 tractor finishes the 4-ha field in 11 hr). Answer = 1 tractor

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: How many outlets for a 15 A overcurrent device?
items.rationale: Under Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) design practice for residential branch circuits (at 180 VA per outlet and 80% continuous load guideline at 220–230 V), a 15 A overcurrent-protected branch circuit is rated for 8 − 10 outlets (while a 20 A branch circuit allows 10 − 12 outlets). Answer = 8 − 10 outlets

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: A branch ckt. of 20 A has how many allowable outlets
items.rationale: Under Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) residential branch-circuit design guidelines (180 VA allowance per outlet and 80% continuous load limit at 220–230 V), a 20 A branch circuit allows 10 − 12 outlets (compared to 8 − 10 outlets for a 15 A branch circuit). Answer = 10 − 12 outlets

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: A 100-hectare area needs to be disc harrowed and programmed to be finished by one tractor in 5 days at 8 hours per day operation. The tractor’s harrowing speed is 7 km/hr while its field efficiency is assumed at 75%. If you are to design the harrow, what should be its width?
items.rationale: Given: A = 100 ha, t = 5 days × 8 hr/day = 40 hr, S = 7 km/hr, Eff = 75% = 0.75. Required EFC = A / t = 100 / 40 = 2.5 ha/hr. Formula: EFC = 0.1 × W × S × Eff -> W = EFC / (0.1 × S × Eff) = 2.5 / (0.1 × 7 × 0.75) = 2.5 / 0.525 = 4.76 m ≈ 5 m. Answer = 5 m

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: Test the field efficiency of a tractor drawing a 4.76-m wide disc harrow and operating at an average speed of 7 km/hr. It completed the harrowing of a 100-hectare field in 40 hours. What is the result of the percent field efficiency test?
items.rationale: Given: W = 4.76 m, S = 7 km/hr, A = 100 ha, t = 40 hr. Formula: EFC = A / t = 100 / 40 = 2.50 ha/hr. TFC = 0.1 × W × S = 0.1 × 4.76 × 7 = 3.332 ha/hr. Field efficiency Eff = (EFC / TFC) × 100% = (2.50 / 3.332) × 100% = 75.03% ≈ 75%. Answer = 75%

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: Test the harrowing field capacity of a tractor drawing a 4.76-meter disc harrow traveling at a speed of 7 km/hr. Earlier test indicated that the field efficiency is 75%. What is the result of the harrowing field capacity test?
items.rationale: Given: W = 4.76 m, S = 7 km/hr, Eff = 75% = 0.75. Formula: EFC = 0.1 × W × S × Eff = 0.1 × 4.76 × 7 × 0.75 = 2.499 ha/hr ≈ 2.5 ha/hr. Answer = 2.5 ha/hr

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: The tractor’s drawbar power is being tested at 7 km/hr travelling speed in a sticky soil. The draft of a disc harrow operating at a speed of 7 km/hr is estimated to be 300 kgf-m when harrowing a sticky soil. The width of the implement is 5 meters. What is the drawbar power?
items.rationale: Given: Speed V = 7 km/hr = 7000 / 3600 m/s = 1.9444 m/s; unit draft = 300 kgf/m (written 300 kgf-m); width W = 5 m. Total draft F = 300 kgf/m × 5 m = 1500 kgf = 1500 × 9.81 N = 14,715 N. Formula: Drawbar power P = F × V = 14,715 N × 1.9444 m/s = 28,612.5 W = 28.61 kW ≈ 29 kW. Answer = 29 kW

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: An Agricultural and Fisheries Mechanization Equipment Service Center (AFMESC). It has the following financial present values: present value of benefits of Php18.83 million and present value of costs of Php9.82 million. What is the center’s Net Present Value and determine if it is feasible or not based on NPV? Use the NEDA published Social Discount Rate (SDR) of 10%.
items.rationale: Given: PV of Benefits = Php 18.83 million, PV of Costs = Php 9.82 million (already discounted at 10% SDR). Formula: NPV = PV(Benefits) − PV(Costs) = Php 18.83M − Php 9.82M = Php 9.01M ≈ Php 9M. Since NPV > 0, the project is financially feasible. Answer = Php 9M, financially feasible

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: You are planning to acquire four-wheel tractor units for the primary tillage of consolidated farm having 1,000 hectares Area (A). Each tractor unit was computed to have a primary tillage field capacity (FC) of 1 hectare/hour. Primary tillage is limited to a working time (T) of 30 working days at 8 working hours/day including related non-tillage working hours. How many tractor units you should request for purchase?
items.rationale: Given: A = 1,000 ha, FC = 1 ha/hr per unit, T = 30 days × 8 hr/day = 240 hr. Formula: Required capacity C_req = A / T = 1,000 ha / 240 hr = 4.17 ha/hr. Number of units N = C_req / FC = 4.17 / 1 = 4.17 units, rounded up to 5 units to complete tillage within 30 working days. Answer = 5 units

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: A tractor pulls a 1.0-meter wide heavy-duty offset-disk harrow at an operating speed of 6 kph. What is the theoretical field capacity of the machine?
items.rationale: Given: Operating width W = 1.0 m, speed V = 6 kph. Formula: TFC = 0.1 × W × V = 0.1 × 1.0 m × 6 kph = 0.6 ha/hr. Answer = 0.6 ha/hr

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: What is the force required to pull a single moldboard plow on a clay loam soil having 30 cm and 15 cm width and depth of cut, respectively. Soil draft is 8 psi.
items.rationale: Given: Width w = 30 cm, depth d = 15 cm, soil draft Ds = 8 psi (lb/in²). Cross-sectional area A = (30 cm / 2.54 cm/in) × (15 cm / 2.54 cm/in) = 11.811 in × 5.9055 in = 69.750 in². Formula: F = A × Ds = 69.750 in² × 8 lb/in² = 558.0 lb. Converting to kg: F = 558.0 lb / 2.2046 lb/kg = 253.1 kg ≈ 253 kg. Answer = 253 kg

items.subtopic: 1.2 Agricultural and Biosystems Mechanization Planning, Operation, Maintenance, Management and Manufacturing
items.question: A single moldboard plow on a clay loam soil (8 psi soil draft) has a 30 cm width of cut and 15 cm depth of cut, requiring a pull force of 253 kg. If the plow has an average speed of 5 km/hr, what is the drawbar horsepower of the plow?
